stories.title: 'The team being hunted': Why things feel -- and look -- different for the Patriots in 2026
stories.summary: After an eventful offseason with much roster turnover, New England is again focusing on identity to combat a harder schedule this season.

stories.title: Source: Saints' Kamara (MCL) out at least 1 month
stories.summary: Saints RB Alvin Kamara is expected to be sidelined for at least the next month due to a sprained MCL, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Sources: Giants trade Faalele to OL-needy Jags
stories.summary: The Giants are trading guard Daniel Faalele to the Jaguars for an undisclosed late-round 2027 draft pick, sources confirmed to ESPN.

stories.title: Kyrgios reveals he tested positive for cocaine
stories.summary: Former Wimbledon finalist Nick Kyrgios revealed on Wednesday he tested positive for cocaine and was provisionally suspended from tennis.

stories.title: LIV players mixed after meeting proposed investor
stories.summary: With LIV Golf's future still murky, players met with CEO Scott O'Neil and the league's proposed new investor Tuesday for about 50 minutes, and while some claimed progress was made, others were noncommittal.
